# ghost/flashcards

Flash Deck (F-Droid): create decks and cards, list decks, review due cards and grade them (again, hard, good, easy). Offline, no account; the Gemini generators are never used.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/flashcards
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/flashcards add_deck --device <serial> --param name=<name>
ghost skill run ghost/flashcards add_card --device <serial> --param deck=<deck> --param question=<question> --param answer=<answer>
ghost skill run ghost/flashcards list_decks --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/flashcards start_review --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/flashcards reveal_answer --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/flashcards grade --device <serial> --param rating=<rating>
ghost skill run ghost/flashcards get_card --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `add_deck`: Create a flashcard deck called Spanish
- `add_card`: Add the card hola / hello to Spanish
- `list_decks`: Which flashcard decks do I have?
- `start_review`: Start studying my flashcards
- `reveal_answer`: Show the answer
- `grade`: Grade this card good
- `get_card`: What card am I on?
